pcs.pc_description: visually check the machine for any damaged, missing, or malfunctioning parts
make certain that all covers and guards are in place
inspect the parking brake / service brake, main horn, reverse horn, headlight and warning lights for mechanical damage
inspect screed plate, tamping bar and screed attack angle for any damages
examine the different controls, gauges, feeders, conveyors, feed control gates, augers, screed, screed heater and sensing and control equipment
ensure that the oil levels in the engine, gearbox, radiator and coolant, as well as the battery electrolyte levels are at the appropriate levels
check the alternator and brackets for tightness
check for leaks in the gearbox, propulsion system and hydraulic hoses and take the appropriate steps according to the operational manual
examine the air-induction system to check that all connections are intact and tight
inspect the air filter indicator for any problems
examine the paver and sensor assemblies for damage, wear and hose leaks
inspect hopper system for wear or damage
inspect operator's cabin, control console steps and hand holds are clean and free of grease, oil, dirt, mud and asphalt
examine the instrument panel, including all gauges for any indications of a problem
enter operating platform using step and grab handles for safety (3point climbing procedure)
check for the dirt evacuator which is located at the bottom of the air filter canister
check the pumps, motors, electrical wires and connections, steps and support for any repairs
check that the propane/LPG cylinder regulator is correctly installed and that the pressure gauges are in excellent working order
spray cleaning solvent or release agent on any part of the paver that comes in contact with asphalt
ensure that daily maintenance inspections and grease are performed in accordance with manufacturer requirements
check that the safety by-pass valve is set correctly
check the engine safety switch for any malfunctioning
inspect the main control unit in cabin and on the screed for proper functioning
ensure fire extinguisher is properly calibrated and available in the site at all times during paving
examine the electronic / manual burner system, as well as the ignition control components and the heating system
check and inspect the main control unit in cabin and on the screed for proper functioning of all machine systems and buttons functionality and emergency stop
check the front wheel assist relief pressure, It should be configured in accordance with the operating surface
inspect the tow arms and the tow cylinder for any cracks or damages
check for track tension and adjust them to the settings prescribed in the manual
maintain a inspection/maintenance log book to record all activities performed before starting the operation
notify the supervisor immediately if a defect is discovered that is outside the scope of the position

modules.module_title: Starting and driving the paver machine

pcs.pc_description: before turning on the paver, make sure the joystick is in the neutral position
fastens the seat belt and adjusts the seat position for comfort and safety
place the throttle in the idle position or press and hold the throttle switch in the up and down positions
start the engine using the starting key on instrument panel
when the engine starts, rechecks all gauges for any unusual noises or malfunctions
preheat paving screed before placing the asphalt as per the set standards
monitor and control temperature during the process to suit the requirements
use the paver controls to lower the screed auger, regulate the hopper, and steer the paver in the direction required by the surface

align the paving machine into position when receiving asphalt by dump truck, and maintain constant flow of asphalt into hopper; ease paver forward, safely pushing dump truck along construction surface
examine the distribution of asphalt materials from the hopper to the conveyor and to the auger along the breadth of the screed
observe distribution of asphalt materials along the screed and control the direction of the screed to eliminate voids at curbs and joints
attach extensions to the screed to change the width according on the surface thickness
before turning off the machinery, park the paver on a flat, smooth area
as per the operator handbook, lower all attachments to ground level
place transmission in neutral
run engine at 1/2 speed (RPM) without load for 3 to 5 minutes
components (such as hoppers, augers, conveyors and extensions) must be cleaned in accordance with manufacturer specifications, company rules and procedures
shut down equipment according to manufacturer's specifications
record input and output flow as per the desired formats of the organization
report to the supervisor of any problems while operating the paver

modules.module_title: Routine maintenance of the paver machine

pcs.pc_description: assess the right service schedule by tracking machine operating hours
check the electronic control unit of the paver for any service / maintenance information
follow instructions concerning safety that are attached onto the vehicle
regularly clean dust in the air filter bowl
refill coolant, lubricants and fluids as needed or as scheduled
check auger chains, conveyor chain, lubricate and adjust if required
check and lubricate all screed points as per manufacturer specifications
remove any debris from screed and check for hose leaks / cylinders leaks
check the battery electrolyte levels and terminal condition and make minor adjustments if necessary
lubricate all grease fittings on the auger flight screw, the fitting on the depth screw and the fittings on the flange bearings located on top of the extension screed
ensure that all tools are stored in the correct location after use
check screws on the rod extensions, tilt screws on the screed pivot
ensure that the diesel-powered wash-down pump is working properly for cleaning the machine
check and maintain the hydraulic fluid level, tire rims, air pressure, wheel nuts and treads as per manufacturer's specifications and guidelines
check for track tension and adjust to the manual's specifications
turn off the mains power from panel completely before carrying out maintenance work, ensure that the battery cut-off switch is used
ensure that no maintenance task on the engine is performed when running or still hot
ensure that appropriate tools are used while troubleshooting
diagnose the problem
handle and dispose waste based on environmental guidelines at the work place
when carrying out welding on the equipment, make sure the battery is unplugged
complete all documents in accordance with the required standards in a timely way
if a fault is found that is outside the scope of his duty, notify the supervisor immediately
